name: Drill freighter
description: Drill freighters were a type of freighter used by the Galactic Republic in the High Republic Era. In 232 BBY, an Emergence—a fragment of the freighter Legacy Run—of the Great Hyperspace Disaster directly struck the Trymant system moon Praknat 3, throwing off the system's gravitational balance and tilting the planet Trymant IV toward the system's second sun. As a result, Trymant IV's aboveground water sources were instantly vaporized.
